clips.title: The story
paras: Magistrate Solomon asks Darkshire for aid as Lakeshire faces mounting threats. His urgent letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke requests the Night Watch to help defend Redridge.

Lakeshire faces attacks from Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs, with few reinforcements arriving from Stormwind. Magistrate Solomon sends a formal plea to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire, asking him to send Night Watch militia north into Redridge. With central military support failing across southern Azeroth, human settlements must seek help from one another to survive.
